Backend tests (4) all pass; frontend UI flow validated end-to-end including login, all 10 sidebar tab navigation, PIN gate unlock (1614), product table headers, action buttons, colored status pill, stock editor modal, backup JSON+Excel exports and Import modal contents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2577 lines — consider splitting into routers per domain (products, backup, admin, pos, etc.) for maintainability.
Backup export loads entire collections (to_list(100000)) into memory; fine for current scale but should stream/paginate at larger scale.
Import merge for id-less docs uses find_one(dict(r)) exact match — safe for skipping exact duplicates but does not handle near-duplicates; acceptable trade-off documented in code.
